test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.**

We have been

P. able to identify certain patterns in

Q. the microbiome and immune response

R. that are clearly linked to the progression and

S. severity of brain injury
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "PQRS." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence P is the first sentence as the paragraph begins with 'We have been.' So we need to use a verb after the helping verb **'have been'** and **'able'** is a verb.
 
• Sentence Q is the second sentence as the previous sentence ended with the preposition 'in'. So the next part should start with a noun or pronoun. Among the options, the noun is **'****the microbiome and immune response.'** Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence R is the third sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'that' and creates a relation with the nouns 'the microbiome and immune response' of the previous sentence.
 
• Finally, sentence S is the last sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__ 

We have been

P. able to identify certain patterns in

Q. the microbiome and immune response

R. that are clearly linked to the progression and

S. severity of brain injury
